ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two plants with labeled parts. The root masses are drawn at the bottom and labeled "Roots." Just above the roots, the vertical plant part is labeled "Stem." Other labels such as Flower, Leaf, Node, and Internode appear higher up on the plants. Reasoning: Reading the diagram from the bottom upward, the part immediately above the roots is the stem. Therefore, the plant part directly above the roots is the stem.
